What_It_Verifies: Single fact checked via two commands
Best_Prompt: Double check this fact using two independent commands. Show both outputs side by side. Flag if they disagree.

What_It_Verifies: Critical fact checked via three commands
Best_Prompt: Triple check using three independent methods. Show all three. Report agreement as 3/3.
Command_Template: git rev-parse HEAD & gh run view [RUN] & docker inspect [IMG]

What_It_Verifies: Fact checked from N independent angles
Best_Prompt: Verify this fact from N independent sources where N >= 3. Report matching count.

What_It_Verifies: Consistency across cloud regions
Best_Prompt: Verify this resource in asia-south1 and us-central1. Report differences.
Command_Template: gcloud run jobs list --region=asia-south1 & gcloud run jobs list --region=us-central1

What_It_Verifies: Cloud console vs CLI consistency
Best_Prompt: Verify using both gcloud CLI and REST API. Compare outputs.
Command_Template: gcloud compute instances list & gcloud logging read [FILTER]

What_It_Verifies: BigQuery vs Google Sheets parity
Best_Prompt: Verify parity between BigQuery and Google Sheets. Show row count & checksums.
Command_Template: bq query 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table' & python sheet_grid.py --count

What_It_Verifies: Current state vs 5 minutes ago
Best_Prompt: Run the same query twice 5 minutes apart. Report if data changed.

What_It_Verifies: Admin user vs Bot service account
Best_Prompt: Run as warghade2012@gmail.com and angel-sheets-bot. Compare results.
Command_Template: gcloud auth login [ADMIN] & gcloud auth activate-service-account [BOT]

What_It_Verifies: ADC credentials vs Service account key
Best_Prompt: Run with Application Default Credentials and with key JSON. Compare.
Command_Template: gcloud auth application-default print-access-token & python test_key.py

What_It_Verifies: Hit 2 regional endpoints
Best_Prompt: Query the API in asia-south1 and us-central1. Compare HTTP status and response body.

What_It_Verifies: Declared table schema vs actual row data
Best_Prompt: Compare declared table schema against actual inserted JSON types. Flag mismatch.
Command_Template: bq show --format=prettyjson [TABLE] & bq query 'SELECT * FROM [TABLE] LIMIT 1'

What_It_Verifies: Deduplication of file copies by SHA256
Best_Prompt: Hash every copy of this script across all directories. Report matches and drifts.

What_It_Verifies: Execution count in logs vs metrics
Best_Prompt: Verify execution count via Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring. Compare.
Command_Template: gcloud logging read 'resource.type=cloud_run_job' & gcloud monitoring metrics list

What_It_Verifies: Billing export vs runtime resource usage
Best_Prompt: Compare Cloud Billing export vs Cloud Run compute usage. Report cost per run.
Command_Template: bq query 'SELECT cost FROM billing_export' & gcloud run jobs describe [JOB]

What_It_Verifies: Local Git HEAD vs GitHub main vs container
Best_Prompt: Verify Git SHA in three places: local repo, GitHub remote, and running image.
Command_Template: git rev-parse HEAD & gh api repos/[REPO]/commits/main & docker exec [C] git rev-parse HEAD

What_It_Verifies: Ping vs HTTP traceroute
Best_Prompt: Run network check from two vantage points to verify connectivity and latency.

What_It_Verifies: Digest vs tag vs build provenance
Best_Prompt: Verify container image by digest, tag, and Cloud Build build ID. Flag drift.

What_It_Verifies: Secret Manager presence vs container env
Best_Prompt: Verify secrets exist in Secret Manager and are correctly bound to Cloud Run env.
Command_Template: gcloud secrets list & gcloud run jobs describe [JOB] --format='yaml(spec.template.spec.template.spec.containers[0].env)'

What_It_Verifies: Rate limit vs current consumed usage
Best_Prompt: Verify rate limit and current usage. Flag if usage exceeds 80% threshold.

What_It_Verifies: Schema state before vs after repair
Best_Prompt: Run bq show before and after any schema change. Diff the two outputs.
Command_Template: bq show --format=prettyjson [TBL] > before.json && bq show --format=prettyjson [TBL] > after.json && git diff before.json after.json

What_It_Verifies: CDN cached payload vs origin server
Best_Prompt: Verify content served by CDN vs origin. Flag if CDN serves stale data.

What_It_Verifies: Source row count vs sink row count
Best_Prompt: Count rows produced at source and written to sink. Delta must be zero.
Command_Template: python -c 'import scanner; print(len(scanner.fetch_quotes()))' & bq query 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM live'

What_It_Verifies: Multiple system clocks skew check
Best_Prompt: Get current time from 3 sources: local laptop, BigQuery, Cloud Logging. Report skew.
Command_Template: Get-Date -Format o & bq query 'SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()' & gcloud logging read 'timestamp' --limit=1

What_It_Verifies: Hash all deployment assets
Best_Prompt: SHA256 every config file and container layer. Report a master fingerprint.

What_It_Verifies: Dev vs Staging vs Production image parity
Best_Prompt: Verify exact same image digest runs in dev, staging, and prod environments.
Command_Template: gcloud run jobs describe [JOB_DEV] & gcloud run jobs describe [JOB_PROD]

What_It_Verifies: Python runtime vs package dependency versions
Best_Prompt: Verify Python version and every package version in requirements.txt. Flag mismatch.

What_It_Verifies: Primary vs backup table row counts
Best_Prompt: Compare primary option_predictions_live and backup snapshot row counts. Flag drift.
Command_Template: bq query 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM live' & bq query 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM backup'

What_It_Verifies: Enumerate all writers holding active lease
Best_Prompt: Enumerate every writer that held a lease today. Report overlaps or split brain.
Command_Template: bq query 'SELECT * FROM transaction_write_lock WHERE lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()'

What_It_Verifies: Alerts fired vs alerts acknowledged in logs
Best_Prompt: Compare fired alerts in monitor_state.json vs acknowledged alerts. Flag unack.

What_It_Verifies: Last recorded pulse vs current clock
Best_Prompt: Compare last heartbeat timestamp in Sheet to current IST time. Flag if > 90s.

What_It_Verifies: Paper trade records across Sheet, CSV, BQ
Best_Prompt: Compare paper trades across OPTION_SHEET, paper_trades.csv, and BQ table.

What_It_Verifies: Verify presence of all 7 production secrets
Best_Prompt: Verify all 7 secrets exist in Secret Manager and are enabled. Report 7/7.
Command_Template: gcloud secrets list --filter='name:(SMARTAPI OR CLIENT OR PIN OR TOTP OR JWT OR SHEETS OR GITHUB)'

What_It_Verifies: List all Cloud Schedulers across regions
Best_Prompt: List all schedulers in asia-south1. Report count and any that are PAUSED.

What_It_Verifies: Match failed job executions to error logs
Best_Prompt: List every failed Cloud Run execution today and every ERROR log line. Cross-match IDs.
Command_Template: gcloud run jobs executions list & gcloud logging read 'severity>=ERROR'

What_It_Verifies: Sum Cloud Run compute and BQ query costs
Best_Prompt: Sum Cloud Run job costs and BQ query costs for today. Report total per run.

What_It_Verifies: Compare freshness of BQ, Sheets, and Git
Best_Prompt: Compare freshness of BQ, Sheets, and Git. Report which storage layer is stalest.

What_It_Verifies: writer_guard vs BigQuery lease table agreement
Best_Prompt: Verify writer guard and lease agreement. Flag if guard lets through what lease rejects.

What_It_Verifies: SHA256 entire artifact chain
Best_Prompt: SHA256 every artifact in chain from git commit to BQ row. Report the chain.

What_It_Verifies: Verify any production claim from >= 5 sources
Best_Prompt: Verify from at least 5 independent sources. Report highest-matching consensus.

What_It_Verifies: Unknown unknowns probe from all accessible layers
Best_Prompt: Enumerate every source that could possibly refute this claim. Report outliers.
